edges.effect_quant: Different designs and subgroups point in different directions, so a single pooled estimate is not the right way to read this edge.
edges.mechanism: Non-nutritive sweeteners may alter microbial substrate use and community structure, though human findings for sucralose remain inconsistent.
edges.summary: For gut microbiome diversity, the most useful starting point is the 2025 Kidangathazhe cohort in Front Microbiol. It found that sucralose produces mixed findings across studies, and the follow-on evidence is broadly consistent even when absolute benefit or harm is modest.
edges.caveats: Subgroup differences, dose thresholds, and competing mechanisms likely explain why the literature does not settle into one clean direction.
